conviction_note: The FY27/5 plan puts construction revenue down 24.7% to 20.5bn yen with real-estate sales making up the difference (23.15bn yen, timing not given), and no real-estate sale was disclosed in Jun-Aug 2026 (last year's Q1 had the Setagaya land sale). So Q1 will most likely show revenue and operating profit down year on year and a progress rate below the 14.8-21.9% of the last two years. But anyone reading the July 短信 can work that out, it sits inside what the company guided, and there was no Q1 forecast revision or capital return in the last three years. So abs_move stays at the 2.51 proxy and p_up 45 gives -0.25. impact_sum is -0.3 (-0.6 weak quarter, +0.3 record order intake already public). The two measurements agree in sign and are close in size.
bar: No quarterly consensus or company quarterly guide; the only company guide is full-year FY27/5 (sales 44,000m, OP 3,500m yen; https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714592848.pdf). The effective bar for the quarter is the prior-year Q1 (sales 7,421m, OP 430m; https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120251014572384.pdf) and the company's own Q1 progress history (OP 21.9% in FY25, 14.8% in FY26; https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=1430). Not two agreeing estimate sources, so every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (none at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-14 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 167x: margin buy 335.1k shares against margin sell 2.0k at 10/09 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=1430), about 2.6% of shares and roughly 17 days of median volume (~20k shares/day). So the margin long is crowded and could sell into a weak quarter, and there is no short to squeeze. Run-up +7.75% over 20 days, a steady climb since the 9/15 優待 expansion. No options and no skew. priced_lean_pct -1.50.

findings.finding: Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026) is likely to print revenue and OP below last year's Q1 (7,421m / 430m yen), with OP progress well under the 14.8-21.9% of the prior two years. The FY27 plan cuts construction revenue 24.7% to 20,500m because last year's large projects completed; the growth comes from 23,150m of real-estate sales with no timing given. The only Q1 real-estate disclosure was a 4bn yen acquisition (Edogawa, funded 8/20), not a sale, whereas last year's Q1 carried the disclosed 7/30/2025 Setagaya land sale.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (2025-10-14, 12:00 release, OP -23.7%): close 1002 -> 954 on the day (-4.8%), about -3.2% from the open to the next close, on a day the whole market fell. Q1 FY25 (2024-10-15, OP +167%): +2.9% over two sessions. So this name has moved about 3% either way on the Q1 line.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The plan structure has been public since 7/15 and FISCO's 8/25 memo spelled out the construction decline. What is not visible is how weak the quarter is: there is no H1 guide, no monthly series and no Q1 consensus. If the market had priced a Q1 OP down 35-45%, the stock would not have climbed 7.75% in 20 days with margin longs at 167x. Lessons rule 1 applies, though: the progress rate can be inferred from the last 短信, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Last year's Q1 segment split (construction 5,726m, real estate 1,645m including the Setagaya sale) is from a different document, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120251014572384.pdf, and the Setagaya sale notice is https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250722/140120250722517541.pdf. The kabutan disclosure list for Jun-Aug 2026 shows no sale notice (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1430&nmode=3). All of it comes from company documents, and the plan cut is the same 短信 the finding cites.

findings.finding: Q1 order intake was 20,611m yen by 31 July 2026 (two July awards, 489 units), 58.9% of the full-year 35,000m order plan, against 2,818m in last year's Q1. Q1 backlog should therefore reach roughly 44bn yen against 28.4bn at the May year-end, which the release will headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent. The 8/10 order disclosure itself moved the stock +0.9% over the next two sessions (1013 -> 1022 -> 1030).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, since it was disclosed on 8/10. What is left is the backlog figure the tanshin will show next to a weak quarter. It may soften a revenue and OP decline and gives the company a reason to hold the plan.
findings.independence: The 350億 order plan and the FY26 Q1 comparison (受注高 2,818m) are in separate company documents: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714592919.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120251014572384.pdf.

outside_window.finding: The FY27 plan depends on 19,750m of real-estate sales plus one large joint-venture completion (共同事業収入 3,400m), and completions cluster in Feb-Mar. Whether H2 delivers it, or the plan is revised, resolves at the H1 (January) or Q3 (April) print.

searched_and_found_nothing: Forecast revision (業績予想の修正) or dividend revision filed before the print: none on TDnet/kabutan since the 2026-07-15 guide (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1430&nmode=3). Kabutan's revision history shows no Q1-print revisions in the last three years (revisions on 24/12/13, 26/04/14) (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=1430)

Buyback history: none recently. The company disposed of 600k treasury shares to 中央日本土地建物 on 8/10 and cancelled 372,300 trust shares on 9/30, so a Q1 buyback is unlikely (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260721597126.pdf)
Order disclosures after 2026-07-31 (August/September awards): none found on kabutan news
Real-estate sale notices for Jun-Aug 2026: none; the only notice is the 4bn yen Edogawa acquisition borrowing (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260721597041.pdf)
四季報/IFIS quarterly consensus: not reachable without a subscription; kabutan's consensus data is premium-only
Company IR news page (https://www.1st-corp.com/ir/news/) renders by JavaScript and returned no list via curl. The IR calendar only confirms 'October: Q1 results'
release_time_source: Inferred from the company's own pattern, not from a notice for today: FY26 Q3 (2026-04-14) and FY26 full-year (2026-07-15) 短信 were released at 13:00 JST, FY26 Q1 (2025-10-14) at 12:00 JST (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1430&nmode=3). Date confirmed on kabutan as 決算発表予定日 2026/10/15 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=1430). Either way it lands before the 15:30 close, so the window runs from the sealed 10:05 spot (1098).
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely; there has been none at a Q1 print in three years and the plan is H2/real-estate weighted. Shareholder returns: unlikely; dividend policy (30% payout, 51 yen) and the 優待 expansion (9/15) are already out, and there is no buyback history. New-year guide: n/a (Q1). Quarter: likely below last year's Q1 and its own 進捗率 (FY25 21.9%, FY26 14.8%) because construction revenue is guided down 24.7% and no Q1 real-estate sale was disclosed.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Crowded margin long (信用倍率 167x, 335k shares) as a separate negative positioning finding
rejected_candidates.detail: Already in the baseline's priced lean (margin_overhang -1.11) and used inside finding 1's why_not_priced; filing it separately would count it twice.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Rising interest costs from the 4bn yen Edogawa borrowing and debt/equity at 1.12x pressuring ordinary profit
rejected_candidates.detail: The notice states the impact is already in the 2026-07-15 FY27 forecast, which already guides ordinary profit growth of only +11.5% against OP +20.9% for this reason.

baseline_tension: Finding 1 agrees with the negative priced lean (-1.5, mostly the 167x margin long) and cuts against the +7.75% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is the record order intake and backlog (filed +0.3, already public) plus a held full-year plan. I looked for a buyback, a dividend change and a forecast raise and found no precedent for any of them at a Q1 print.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): finding 1 cut from -1.0 to -0.6, and p_up moved from 41 to 45, so expected_move went from -0.45 to -0.25. The construction decline lands inside what the company guided; only the real-estate timing is unguided.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positive (order intake and backlog, a held plan) is stated in baseline_tension and filed. I had already looked for buybacks, dividends and a revision, so nothing further moved; finding 2 stays at +0.3.
